assumptions: Exactly 100 physical cards and 99 library cards, no mulligan, initial seven, one own-turn draw beginning turn one
Identical shuffle seeds and library positions except exact physical swapped card; fetchland shuffling and target changes may cause later divergence

At most one land drop each own turn; fixed transparent land choice; mapped Grixis basics, duals, shocks, fetches, bond lands, City, Mana Confluence, Urborg, Otawara, Takenuma, Ancient Tomb and Xander's Lounge
Exotic Orchard produces no guaranteed color in this conservative model; all other unsupported effects fail unmodeled
Held spells are not actually cast; assess individual printed-cost source affordability on a hypothetical cleared-main-phase snapshot, never simultaneous payments or established board states
No rocks, rituals, mana creatures, tutors, cascade flips, draw spells, opponents, removal, alternate-cost lines, triggers, land abilities beyond specified mana
Exact draw-only hypergeometric combinatorics are separate from seeded land-source snapshots; never interpret as multiplayer win likelihood
Do not mark an Assault-Neheb-Loyal three-piece draw proxy as actual engine assembly or actual win
measurements: per-checkpoint selected singleton observed in initial hand plus draws
per-checkpoint held slot with color-accurate land-only printed-cost source payment feasibility
per-checkpoint held Neheb and Loyal and Assault and source-paid individual cost snapshots (not a combined legal sequence)
exact hypergeometric raw physical library observation probabilities for a singleton and 2/3 target groups
hard_gates: Fail if source physical inventory or source hash differs
Fail if replacements not 100 singleton-compliant and one slot only
Fail if symbolic source planner fails specified UBR/BBRR/R/RR cases and does not handle Ancient Tomb correctly
Never promote M6.6, M6.7, M6 certificate, I/J, M7 or 100-card canonical authority based on these proxies
